EmailTemplate.subject: Last chance to join! [WEBINAR] Simplify Your 1098-T Process
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
[WEBINAR] Simplify Your 1098-T Process Learn more about Flywire's new offering. Join us for an informative webinar on Thursday April 15, 1pm ET to learn more about Flywire's new 1098-T offering that enables institutions to provide 1098-T forms to students and authorized users directly from within the Flywire solution.
During this webinar, we'll share how easy it is for institutions to deliver 1098-T forms to students and authorized users electronically, or via our printing and mailing services, a demonstration of our 1098-T offering and integration options with Banner and PeopleSoft.
Speakers: David King - CTO, Flywire Corey Rethage - Director, Product Management, Flywire
<[[https://more.flywire.com/webinar-simplify-your-1098-T-process.html]]>
